title: At 14, he cold-called the Yellow Pages for a job. Some nights, dinner was expired bread dipped in milk.
caption:
At 14, he cold-called the Yellow Pages for a job. Some nights, dinner was expired bread dipped in milk.

Peter Thiel wrote him a check to quit Microsoft. He said no. He says that cost him $200 million.

He gave Brian Armstrong an "infinite" score at YC. His fund backed Coinbase.

That kid is Garry Tan. He now runs Y Combinator.

Would you have cashed Thiel's check?
